metric: Magnitude and direction of monthly mean velocity vector, NOT mean current speed
directionConvention: Towards, clockwise from true north; u eastward and v northward. Direction suppressed below 0.0001 m/s for near-zero residual vectors.
coastalGapFillMethod: Optional IDW squared of up to 4 valid source centres within 2500 m, applied to u and v separately; geometric extrapolation only, not hydrodynamic simulation. Original values stay null.
method: Bilinear source interpolation with optional bounded coastal estimates as flagged per sample; currents interpolate u/v before magnitude and direction. No temporal filling.
